steps.text: A new lead comes in. It is 7 AM for the lead. Do you call now? No. Here is why.
You may call leads only at set hours. We call this the calling window. These rules protect you and your client.

cards.back: 9 AM to 8 PM, the lead's time.
Noon to 8 PM, the lead's time.
Shorter hours. Your coordinator tells you before you dial.

steps.text: The lead's clock counts. Not your clock.
steps.sub: The lead may live in a different time zone.

steps.q: It is 8:30 PM for the lead. Can you send a text?
options: No. Texts follow the same hours.
steps.why: Texts follow the calling window too.

steps.q: A lead comes in at 7 AM their time. What do you do?
steps.why: Wait for the window. Then call first.

steps.text: A lead says "STOP", "remove me" or "don't call". That lead is now DNC. You stop right away.

options.text: Sorry! Just one quick question first?
options.why: Stop means stop. Never ask again.

options.text: Why? I only want to help you.
options.why: Never argue with a lead who says stop.

options.text: I'm sorry about that. I will remove you right now.
options.why: Kind, short and done. Now tag the lead DNC.

steps.h: A lead says STOP. Put your steps in order
items: Set the stage to Archived / DNC

steps.q: Can you delete a DNC lead?
options: Yes, to keep the list clean
No. Keep the lead and the DNC tag.
steps.why: The tag tells the whole team never to call again.

steps.text: STOP means stop. Tag DNC. Never argue. Never delete.
steps.sub: This protects you and your client.

steps.line: I'm sorry about that. I will remove you right now. Have a good day.

steps.text: An inbound lead asked for a call. You may call them inside the window. Other lists have one more rule.

cards.back: They asked to be contacted. OK to call in the window.
Call only after it is scrubbed.
Checked against the Do Not Call lists.
Ask your coordinator before you dial.

steps.q: Your client sends an old list of 200 names. What is first?
options: Ask if the list was scrubbed
steps.why: Old lists must be scrubbed before any call.

steps.text: Text only leads who agreed to get texts. No yes, no text.

steps.q: A lead never agreed to texts. They did not answer. What now?
options: Do not text. Call again later.
steps.why: No yes, no text. Call again inside the window.

steps.text: You dial each number yourself. No robot dialers. No recorded sales messages.

items.text: Leave a voicemail in my own voice
Text a lead who said STOP

steps.text: On every call, say the call may be recorded. Say it at the start.

steps.line: Hi Maria, this is Sofia with Dana Lee's team. This call may be recorded.

options.text: Done. I am removing you now. Take care.
options.why: "Remove me" means DNC. You stopped right away.

options.text: OK. Can I text you next month?
options.why: Never ask again after a lead says stop.

steps.text: Great job! You know when to call, when to stop and what to say.

quiz.q: A lead says "STOP CALLING ME." What do you do?
options: Say sorry, stop and tag DNC
quiz.explain: Stop means stop. Never argue. Never delete.

quiz.q: When can you call on Sunday?
quiz.explain: Sunday starts at noon. Texts follow the same hours.
The window uses the lead's local time.

quiz.q: What do you say on every call?
quiz.explain: Always say the call may be recorded.
